description: This Java class 'DefaultTbResourceService' implements resource management functionalities for the Thingsboard platform, including saving, deleting, exporting, and importing resources, as well as handling LwM2mObject retrieval and sorting.

classes.name: DefaultTbResourceService
classes.description: Service class for managing resources in Thingsboard, including CRUD operations, exporting, importing, and handling LwM2mObjects.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a resource, handling special cases for LWM2M models and resource keys.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource, with permission checks and logging.

methods.name: findLwM2mObject
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LwM2mObjects based on tenant ID and object IDs, with sorting.

methods.name: findLwM2mObjectPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of LwM2mObjects with sorting.

methods.name: exportResources
methods.description: Exports resources related to dashboards or widget types, with permission checks.

methods.name: importResources
methods.description: Imports resources from provided data, handling images and other resource types.

methods.name: exportResources (private)
methods.description: Helper method to gather and export resources with permission validation.

methods.name: importResource
methods.description: Imports a single resource, with permission checks.

methods.name: getComparator
methods.description: Returns a comparator for LwM2mObject based on sort property and order.
